name: PT-141
subtitle: Bremelanotide
summary: FDA-approved for low desire — the one libido peptide with real prescribing data behind it.
caveat: Approved for premenopausal women with low desire; nausea and transient blood-pressure rise are common.

dosing.source: Vyleesi (bremelanotide) US Prescribing Information, 2019 — no more than one dose per 24 hours or eight per month
